Government proposes bill to criminalize "insult" to Vande Mataram

The Indian government is set to introduce a bill in the Rajya Sabha that aims to criminalize the "insult" or disruption of Vande Mataram. This proposed legislation seeks to provide Vande Mataram with legal protection similar to that of the national anthem, potentially carrying a jail term of up to three years. The move comes months after the Supreme Court stated that not singing Vande Mataram does not impose any penal provision.
